_comment: Agentic layer INSIDE the backend (same deployable). LangGraph and related skills are topics of the backend front, not a separate 'ai' front. Declare a separate 'ai' front only when the agents are their own deployable with their own folder, checks and release cycle.

decisions.agentic-layer: In-process module of the backend (for example backend/app/agents/). It follows the backend standards for layout, typing and tests; LangGraph skills are loaded only for tasks that touch it.
